_comment: Per-subsystem mutation-score floors. These are this project's engineering
targets, not universal standards -- the source document says so
explicitly. What they are for is the comparison against coverage: a high
coverage number with a poor mutation score is weak evidence, and these
numbers are what makes that comparison possible.
'paths' are the modules mutated. 'min_score' is the fraction of generated
mutants the suite must kill. A subsystem whose score falls below its
floor fails the nightly job; it does not block a pull request, because a
mutation run is minutes of CPU per module and a PR gate that slow gets
